senses.gloss: ch. (b. h. כֹּה, v. preced.) adverb of place: here, v. הָכָא; of time: now.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:11">Targ. Job XXXVIII, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ top וכא אמר הכין and here he says so? Ib. וכה; a. v. fr.—לְכָא hither; מִיכָּא from here.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 8:20">Targ. Josh. VIII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 17:12">Targ. Ex. XVII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:2:7">Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ</cite> <he>פצל … לכא ולכא</he> skimmed the water in both directions.

VI, 11ᵃ</cite> top <he>מיכא ללוד</he> from here to Lydda; a. fr.—v. <cite ref="A01249"><he>אִיכָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00460"><he>לִיכָּא</he></cite> &c.; <cite ref="K00021"><he>כַּאַן</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00825"><he>כַּן</he></cite> &c.
